dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical 2D geometric narrowing from the mid-section toward the visible posterior peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light-to-medium grey baseline skin tone with uniform reflectance across the primary dorsal area.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, subtle darker-grey patches observed primarily along the mid-dorsal left lateral margin.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse, soft-gradient transitions between localized pigmented patches and the primary light-grey canvas.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Visible pale linear marks (rake-like) on the mid-dorsal left; two distinct, high-contrast white circular spots on the anterior cephalic region.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Linear longitudinal indentation/ridge visible along the central axis of the posterior dorsal segment.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Healed linear pale marks on the mid-dorsal left; localized white spots on the head.
other_distinctive_markers: Prominent, high-contrast dark circular blowhole aperture on the cephalic region.
